The one ISRO item from 9 to 12 Nov 2026 is a successful ground test of the PSLV third stage (PS3) on Thu 12 Nov 2026 at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota. It was a test on the ground, not a launch.

Why it was needed: the third stage showed problems on the PSLV-C61/EOS-09 and PSLV-C62/EOS-N1 missions. ISRO then reviewed the stage's design, raw material checks, assembly and quality checks.

What changed:

Stronger nozzle design, with better safety margins
Updated rules for accepting raw materials
Updated assembly steps and non-destructive tests during integration and transport
Stronger mechanical joints, with backup in the sealing systems

ISRO says it will plan further tests after studying the test data. This comes from one report (Amar Ujala, quoting ISRO's statement shared by ANI). I did not find a second source, and no launch date was given.
